# webOS shell protocol

source: SDL-webOS revision
`ba4c86af391d1524d3ff0cb61dc3b10035933239`,
`wayland-protocols/webos-shell.xml`.

upstream: https://github.com/webosbrew/SDL-webOS

the matching client header and private protocol code in `src/native/`
were generated with wayland-scanner 1.23.1 and tested on the B9.
they are kept in source so normal builds do not require a host scanner.
the upstream license is preserved in LICENSE.txt.
